content: Definition of the Resilient Zone: According to Elaine Miller of the Trauma Research Institute, a resilient zone is defined as a state of equilibrium where we feel balanced and capable of dealing with stressful or traumatic experiences. It does not stop us from experiencing emotions such as anger or sadness, but it helps us retain control over our thoughts and actions during those moments.

content: Ancient Indian Metaphor: An ancient Indian metaphor teaches heedfulness through the story of a person ordered to carry a bowl filled to the brim with hot sesame oil while a guard holding a drawn sword walks behind him.
